resources.string: Show your calendars in the phone\'s calendar apps
Show in the phone\'s calendar apps
Your calendars and events appear in the calendar app you use on this phone, and what you change there goes back to the server.
Only your own calendars are shown. Calendars other people share with you are never copied to the phone.
There are no calendars to show.

Events that do not repeat can be changed in either place. Repeating events are shown in the phone\'s calendar and changed here or on the server; a change made to one on the phone is put back. Reminders stay with this app, so nothing reminds you twice.
Sync is switched off for this account in Android\'s settings.

To show your calendars on this phone, the app needs to read and write the phone\'s calendar. Other apps that can read the phone\'s calendar will be able to read what is copied there. Nothing is copied before you switch this on, and it is taken away when you switch it off.
Without the calendar permission nothing can be shown on the phone. You can allow it in the app\'s settings.
